note: BULK TISSUE postmortem RNA-seq: median across donors of a whole-tissue homogenate. CANNOT resolve cell types - the value is a weighted average over every cell in the organ, so a high-expressing rare cell type (e.g. mast cell, microglia) is diluted and a low-but-abundant cell type (hepatocyte, neuron) dominates. Use as an organ-level floor/sanity check only. GTEx donors are postmortem, so an agonal/ischemic inflammatory component may inflate CASP1/IL18 above a truly resting baseline.
